prompt:
Dublin Ltd is taking out a leasing agreement for five years. Dublin must pay £24,000 at the beginning of the first year as a deposit, to be followed by four equal payments at the beginning of years two, three, four and five. At a discount rate of 10%, the present value of the four equal payments is £63,590.

The total amount to be paid during the lease period is:

	£112,258
	£104,240
	£96,380
	£87,590
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: 1) Compute the total amount payable during the lease (numeric, matching one of the given options) 2) Provide a single, non-truncated, non-contradictory final answer. Candidate 1’s final answer (£104,240) matches the correct option, though the intermediate reasoning is inconsistent and contains arithmetic mistakes. Candidate 2 incorrectly treats the given PV as if it were the nominal sum (final £87,590), Candidate 3 applies the wrong annuity timing and ends with £96,380 (wrong), and Candidate 4 is malformed/truncated and finishes with an inconsistent/incorrect committed answer (£18,239.34).
